messages:
maddie: Quick follow-up from the RFC yesterday on token lifecycle abstraction + 'admin buckets' for org-level admin keys. TL;DR: idea is a separate long-lived admin bucket per org that issues short-lived per-service tokens via exchange. Wanted to surface migration concerns and SDK implications. Thoughts?

omar: Looks clean in theory. Curious about discovery: how do services find the right admin bucket for a given org?

maddie: Plan is to include org_id in token audience and use a small auth-registry service with cached mapping in the SDKs. Fallback is a control-plane lookup endpoint (like DNS for orgs).

jess: Cache invalidation will bite. We need push notifications or a config watch so services don't fail auth on rotations.

pranav: Agree. Push via control-plane pubsub + local watcher + bumpable token TTL. Recommend ~5m TTL for per-service tokens, 24h for intermediate tokens when offline.

infra-bot: deploy: auth-registry v2 deployed to prod in us-east-1. Rolling 3/3.

leo: What about RBAC? Does admin bucket bypass policy checks or will we still evaluate resource policies?

maddie: Admin bucket issues tokens with an admin claim. We do NOT bypass policy store — the policy evaluator uses admin claim to short-circuit some checks but auditors/audit log still record decisions.

carol: Edge case: support/ops need temporary cross-tenant access. Proposal: 'support-sudo' tokens minted from admin bucket with timeboxed scopes and mandatory audit annotations.

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: Audit hooks must be enforced. Also add rate limits to token mint endpoints to avoid mass escalation during a support incident.

omar: SDK work: add automatic exchange helper (opt-in behind feature flag). It should handle refresh headers and retries.

jess: Rotation question: if we rotate the KMS key used by admin buckets, how do outstanding per-service tokens remain valid? Maybe derive per-service signing keys via KMS envelope + versioned salt.

maddie: Proposed: per-service tokens are signed by short-lived intermediate keys minted by the admin bucket. On rotation, admin bucket keeps old intermediates valid until TTLs expire; new exchanges use new intermediates.

pranav: Migration path idea: 1) SDK supports exchange flow; 2) Provision admin buckets for top 100 orgs; 3) Teams opt-in; 4) Full enforcement after 90 days with rollback window.

leo: Also ensure tokens carry org/project/service claims for billing/usage attribution.

carol: For Private deployments, admin bucket and auth-registry run in customer control plane and use customer KMS; need offline support and local audit export.

infra-bot: ticket INFRA-5123 created to add pubsub watch + SDK config hook.

jess: Quick snippet we should add to SDK README:

```
POST /v1/exchange
{
  "grant_type": "admin_exchange",
  "admin_token": "<admin-bucket-token>",
  "target_service": "svc-a",
  "org_id": "org-123"
}
```

maddie: Great notes. I'll update the RFC with the migration checklist + SDK PR checklist. Thanks all.
